result.title: PASTA: Prompt-Aware Annealed Diffusion Sampling
result.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to ICONIP2026
result.summary: While Diffusion models produce high-quality images, real-world visual design requires intentionally preserving clean regions for headlines, logos, or UI elements. Existing layout-aware text-to-image methods struggle to strictly preserve reserved regions, often introducing unwanted content that complicates downstream editing. Existing approaches either manipulate attention to displace content or suppress conditioning via noise-level interventions. However, these methods sacrifice visual coherence, producing flat regions or noticeable style inconsistencies between reserved and non-reserved areas. To address this limitation, we propose a Prompt-Aware Shared-Latent Training-Free Annealed Diffusion Sampling (PASTA), a training-free framework that enforces reserved-region constraints by selectively applying semantic guidance to object-allowed regions during sampling. PASTA operates on a shared latent trajectory, where full-prompt and context-prompt guidance are fused through mask-guided sampling. An annealed schedule suppresses semantic leakage during early denoising stages while gradually restoring visual consistency in later stages. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PASTA improves reserved-region fidelity while preserving overall image realism and perceptual consistency.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的扩散采样框架 PASTA，通过在采样中用掩码将完整提示与上下文提示的语义引导融合于共享 latent 轨迹，并按退火调度抑制早期语义泄漏，以严格保留版式指定区域。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于图像生成中的版式保留采样控制，其 latent 仅指扩散去噪状态，与视觉推理中的 latent 表示、证据筛选或停止决策无实质联系。
